# Timer on T3

Read on 2026-11-03, and its response fields on 2026-11-04; no real timer was created. Tags: [T] the
tool's own description here, [I] inference, [?] not verified. Listed evidence is what this file
checks, not proof of future delivery.

- **Evidence before setting:** `list_scheduled_tasks` succeeds this turn [T][I].
- **Set:** `schedule_task`, `once`, this thread by default [T]. Its `runAt` format is not verified [?].
- **Record it only when** the response shows `enabled` true, no `blockedByPolicy`, and a returned
  `nextRunAt` [T]. That `nextRunAt` is the time to record, and `scheduledTaskId` the handle.
  Otherwise, or if the call refuses, cancel any handle created and return `unavailable` with the
  returned reason.
- **Cancel:** `delete_scheduled_task` [T].
- **Runs with no active turn:** scheduled work "runs with no turn active" [T]. What happens if a turn
  is active at that time is not verified [?].
- **Survives:** a closed client only if the server runs [I]. Delivery and survival stay unproved until
  a real check, and the `survives` text you return says so.
